_comment: pc-maintenance: ongoing Windows housekeeping as pluggable modules. Report-only unless the dispatcher gets -Apply AND the module declares AutoApply. Framework borrowed from a sibling project; the task cadence here is WEEKLY, with no Group Policy triggers, because nothing this tool watches is caused by a policy refresh.
_task_note: The schedule is NOT configured here. It lives in task_template.xml, which the installer substitutes and registers; the task name is a constant in Install-/Uninstall-PcMaintenance.ps1. A 'task' block here would look load-bearing and silently do nothing, so there deliberately is not one.
_reportsToKeep_note: How many HTML dashboards to leave in the user's Downloads. 2 keeps this run and the one before it, which is what makes the week-over-week delta readable without Downloads filling up.
